words.example: A fluorescent bulb gives cooler light than an incandescent bulb.
words.exampleTranslation: 荧光灯发出的光比白炽灯凉。

evidence.quote: Fluorescent bulbs are very popular because they emit cooler light
Fluorescent lights also do not heat up objects underneath the lamp, as do high-watt incandescent bulbs.

words.example: Never use a bead sterilizer in a salon: it can spread disease.
words.exampleTranslation: 沙龙里绝不能用玻璃珠消毒器：它可能传播疾病。

evidence.quote: Electric sterilizers, bead sterilizers, and baby sterilizers should not be used to disinfect or sterilize implements.
These devices can spread potentially infectious diseases and should never be used in a salon

words.example: A paraffin tub's thermostat keeps the wax at the right temperature.
words.exampleTranslation: 蜡疗机的恒温器让蜡保持在合适的温度。

evidence.quote: A paraffin tub has an automatic thermostat that maintains the paraffin at the ideal temperature for application to the hands and feet.

words.example: Torque is the file's power to keep turning under pressure.
words.exampleTranslation: 扭力是打磨机在受压时还能继续转动的力量。

evidence.quote: is understood as the power of the machine or its ability to keep turning when you are applying pressure during filing

words.example: A micromotor file has its motor inside the handpiece.
words.exampleTranslation: 微电机打磨机的电机装在手柄里。

evidence.quote: are known as micromotor machines, because the motor is located in the handpiece

words.example: RPM counts how many full turns the bit makes each minute.
words.exampleTranslation: RPM 是磨头每分钟转的整圈数。

evidence.quote: The speed of an electric file is measured in revolutions per minute (RPM)
This is the number of times in a minute that the bit spins in a complete circle.

words.example: A concentric bit is balanced, so it spins without wobbling.
words.exampleTranslation: 同心磨头很平衡，转动时不会晃动。

evidence.quote: are balanced bits that do not wobble or vibrate

words.example: Carbide bits shave product; never use them on natural nails.
words.exampleTranslation: 钨钢磨头会刮削产品，绝不能用在真甲上。

evidence.quote: which shave the surface of the product as they file
Never use a carbide bit on the natural nail!

words.example: A sanding band is paper, so throw it away after one use.
words.exampleTranslation: 砂圈是纸做的，用一次就要扔掉。

evidence.quote: These are one-use-only paper bits that slip onto a mandrel.
made of abrasive paper just like hand files and cannot be disinfected

words.example: The UL mark shows an electric tool's safety is certified.
words.exampleTranslation: UL 标志说明这件电器的安全经过认证。

evidence.quote: Underwriters Laboratories (UL) certifies the safety of electrical appliances.
Always look for the UL symbol on electric appliances

words.example: Grounding carries current safely away and protects you from shock.
words.exampleTranslation: 接地能把电流安全地导走，保护你不触电。

evidence.quote: completes an electric circuit and carries the current safely away
The grounding pin is designed to guarantee a safe path for electricity and protect the user from electrical shock

words.example: A fuse melts when too much current runs through the circuit.
words.exampleTranslation: 电路里电流过大时，保险丝会熔断。

evidence.quote: prevents excessive current from passing through a circuit
It is designed to blow out or melt when the wire becomes too hot from overloading the circuit with too much current

words.example: Multiuse implements are usually stainless steel, so they can be disinfected.
words.exampleTranslation: 可重复使用的工具通常用不锈钢做，所以能消毒。

evidence.quote: are generally stainless steel, as they must be properly cleaned and disinfected prior to use on another client
They must be stainless steel in order to be disinfected after use.

words.example: A metal pusher gently scrapes cuticle tissue off the nail plate.
words.exampleTranslation: 钢推用来轻轻刮掉甲面上的死皮组织。

evidence.quote: It is designed to gently scrape cuticle tissue from the natural nail plate.

words.example: Nail nippers trim dead skin; never use them on live skin.
words.exampleTranslation: 死皮剪用来修剪死皮，绝不能用来剪活皮。

evidence.quote: used to carefully trim away dead skin around the nails. It is never used to cut, rip, or tear live tissue

words.example: Put your index finger on the nippers' box joint for control.
words.exampleTranslation: 把食指放在死皮剪的剪轴上，更好控制。

evidence.quote: Your index finger is placed on the box joint to help control the blade and guide it properly

words.example: A lower grit number means bigger grains and a rougher file.
words.exampleTranslation: 目数越低，颗粒越大，锉条越粗。

evidence.quote: the lower the grit, the larger the abrasive particles on the file
and the more aggressive its action

words.example: A curette has a small scoop for cleaning out the nail folds.
words.exampleTranslation: 刮匙有一个小勺头，用来清理甲沟。

evidence.quote: is an implement with a small scoop-shaped end that, if used carefully, allows for more efficient removal of debris from the nail folds

words.example: A wooden pusher is single-use: throw it away after one client.
words.exampleTranslation: 木棒是一次性的：给一位顾客用完就扔掉。

evidence.quote: It is a single-use implement and not intended for reuse or disinfection.
All single-use implements are used once on a client. They are then discarded

words.example: A nail rasp files the sides of the free edge.
words.exampleTranslation: 甲沟锉用来锉指甲前缘的两侧。

evidence.quote: to reduce the sides of the free edge that might grow into the tissues
Never use it on the top of the nail

words.example: A foot file, or pedicure paddle, smooths thick calluses.
words.exampleTranslation: 脚锉（也叫修脚板）用来磨平厚茧。

evidence.quote: or pedicure paddle, is designed to reduce and smooth thicker foot calluses

words.example: Synthetic hair brushes can be disinfected; natural hair brushes cannot.
words.exampleTranslation: 合成毛刷可以消毒，天然毛刷不能。

evidence.quote: Synthetic hair brushes can be cleaned and disinfected by immersion.
natural hair nail brushes cannot be cleaned or disinfected and should be discarded after use

words.example: Use a medium-grit abrasive to shape the natural nail.
words.exampleTranslation: 用中目数的锉条修整真甲的形状。

evidence.quote: Use a medium-grit abrasive to shape the natural nail.

words.example: Use a three-way buffer from the lowest grit to the shine side.
words.exampleTranslation: 三面抛光条要从目数最低的一面用起，最后用抛光面。

evidence.quote: Begin with the lowest-grit abrasive surface in the smoothing task
and then finally on to the shining surface (usually no grit)

words.example: A white terry cloth towel can be bleached between uses.
words.exampleTranslation: 白色毛巾每次用完洗的时候都可以漂白。

evidence.quote: The best terry cloth towel for use in a personal service is white, as it can be bleached during washing between uses.

words.example: Plastic-backed pads keep drying solvents off your fingertips.
words.exampleTranslation: 背面带塑料膜的棉片能挡住让皮肤变干的溶剂，保护你的指尖。

evidence.quote: Plastic backing protects nail professionals’ fingertips from overexposure to drying solvents and other chemicals

words.example: An exfoliating scrub is a gritty lotion that removes dry skin.
words.exampleTranslation: 去角质磨砂膏是一种含颗粒的乳液，能去除干皮。

evidence.quote: A gritty lotion is massaged on the foot and leg to remove dry, flaky skin and reduce calluses.
is usually a water-based lotion that contains an abrasive as the exfoliating agent

words.example: Toe separators keep the toes apart while you polish toenails.
words.exampleTranslation: 给脚指甲涂甲油时，分趾器能把脚趾分开。

evidence.quote: are used to keep the toes apart while the technician is polishing

words.example: A protein hardener only coats the surface; it doesn't soak in.
words.exampleTranslation: 蛋白硬甲油只在甲面形成一层涂层，不会渗进指甲。

evidence.quote: This provides a clear, hard coating on the surface of the nail but does not change or affect the natural nail plate itself.
Protein (collagen) has very large molecules that cannot be absorbed into the nail plate.

words.example: Nail cream is a barrier: it seals moisture into the skin.
words.exampleTranslation: 护甲霜是一层屏障：把水分锁在皮肤里。

evidence.quote: are barrier products: They contain ingredients designed to seal the surface of the skin around the nails and hold in the subdermal moisture in the skin

words.example: A foot soak is added to pedicure water to soften the skin.
words.exampleTranslation: 泡脚粉/泡脚液加进修脚水里，用来软化皮肤。

evidence.quote: is a product that is added to the water in the pedicure bath to soften the skin on the feet

words.example: Lacquer, enamel, and varnish are other names for nail polish.
words.exampleTranslation: lacquer、enamel 和 varnish 都是指甲油的别称。

evidence.quote: Colored coatings applied to the natural nail plate are variously known as polish, enamel, lacquer, or varnish.
All of these terms are actually marketing terms used to describe the same types of products

words.example: Topcoat goes over colored polish to stop chipping and add shine.
words.exampleTranslation: 亮油涂在彩色甲油上面，防止剥落，增加光泽。

evidence.quote: Topcoats are applied over colored polish to prevent chipping and to add a shine or a matte finish to the nail.

words.example: Pumice can be the gritty part of a pedicure scrub.
words.exampleTranslation: 浮石粉可以是修脚磨砂膏里的颗粒成分。

evidence.quote: Sea sand, ground apricot kernels, pumice, quartz crystals, and jojoba beads are exfoliating agents that may be found in pedicure scrubs.

words.example: Corn meal can expand and clog the pedicure drain.
words.exampleTranslation: 玉米粉会膨胀，堵塞修脚盆的下水口。

evidence.quote: avoid using products with ingredients that will expand and clog the pedicure drain, such as corn meal

words.example: Callus softeners soften thick calluses; wear safety glasses with alkaline ones.
words.exampleTranslation: 去茧软化剂能软化厚茧；用碱性的去茧软化剂时要戴护目镜。

evidence.quote: product designed to soften and smooth thickened calluses
Some callus softeners are alkaline and potentially hazardous.
safety glasses should be worn whenever those types of products are used or poured

meaning.en: Tools like the table, lamp, and finger bowl
meaning.zh: 像美甲桌、台灯、泡手碗这样的用具

meaning.en: Hand tools like nippers, pushers, and tweezers
meaning.zh: 像死皮剪、推棒、镊子这样的手持工具

meaning.en: Used once, then replaced, like cotton and gauze
meaning.zh: 用一次就换新的，比如棉花和纱布

tip.en: Implements fit in your hand. Equipment stays at your station. Supplies get used up and replaced.
tip.zh: 工具（implements）拿在手里。设备（equipment）放在工位上不动。耗材（supplies）：“耗”就是用掉，用完换新的。

evidence.quote: Equipment includes all tools used to perform nail services that are not implements.
Describe the Equipment Needed to Perform Nail Services
A finger bowl is used for soaking the client’s fingers in warm water
Implements are tools used to perform your services.
Tweezers are multiuse implements that can be used for lifting small bits of debris
Materials and supplies used during a manicure are designed to be single use and must be replaced for each client.
Gauze squares, cotton rounds, or cotton balls are also popular for removing nail polish

meaning.en: Cooler light; doesn't heat things below
meaning.zh: 光比较凉，不会把下面的东西烤热

meaning.en: Gets very hot; can speed up curing
meaning.zh: 会变得很烫，可能让产品固化太快

tip.en: Incandescent has "cand", like candle: hot like a flame. Fluorescent light stays cooler.
tip.zh: incandescent 里有 cand，想想 candle（蜡烛）：像火一样烫。中文“白炽灯”的“炽”有火字旁：很烫。荧光灯的光比较凉。

evidence.quote: Fluorescent bulbs are very popular because they emit cooler light
Fluorescent lights also do not heat up objects underneath the lamp, as do high-watt incandescent bulbs.
Higher temperatures caused by an incandescent bulb can increase the curing speed of some nail enhancement products.
Light bulbs, especially incandescent ones, can become very hot while in use

meaning.en: Melts when too much current flows
Shuts off the circuit; you reset it
meaning.zh: 自动切断电路，可以复位再用

tip.en: A fuse melts, so you put in a new one. A circuit breaker is a switch you turn back on.
tip.zh: 保险丝会熔断，要换一根新的。断路器是一个开关，检查好后把它重新打开就行。

evidence.quote: It is designed to blow out or melt when the wire becomes too hot from overloading the circuit with too much current
insert a new fuse, then reconnect the appliance
is a switch that automatically interrupts or shuts off an electric circuit at the first indication of an overload
can simply be reset by switching the circuit breaker back on

meaning.en: Trims dead skin with two sharp blades
meaning.zh: 用两片锋利的刀刃修剪死皮

meaning.en: Gently scrapes cuticle off the nail plate
meaning.zh: 把死皮从甲面上轻轻刮掉

meaning.en: Small scoop that cleans out the nail folds
meaning.zh: 小勺形工具，用来清理甲沟

tip.en: Nippers snip like tiny scissors. A pusher pushes on the nail plate. A curette scoops out the folds.
tip.zh: 死皮剪像小剪刀一样剪。钢推在甲面上推、刮。刮匙 = 刮 + 匙（小勺子）：把甲沟里的脏东西舀出来。

evidence.quote: is a stainless-steel implement used to carefully trim away dead skin around the nails
with the blades facing the nail plate
Always maintain a sharp edge on your nippers
It is designed to gently scrape cuticle tissue from the natural nail plate.
is an implement with a small scoop-shaped end that, if used carefully, allows for more efficient removal of debris from the nail folds

meaning.en: Removes product fast; leaves deep scratches
meaning.zh: 磨得快，留下很深的刮痕

meaning.en: Buffs, polishes, and removes tiny scratches
meaning.zh: 抛光、上光、去掉细小刮痕

tip.en: Coarse: big, rough grains, low number. Fine: tiny grains like flour, high number. Medium shapes natural nails.
tip.zh: 粗目数（coarse）：颗粒大又粗，数字低。细目数（fine）：颗粒细得像面粉，数字高。中目数（medium）用来修真甲形状。

evidence.quote: the lower the grit, the larger the abrasive particles on the file
files and buffers (100 or less grit) quickly reduce any surface and produce deeper and more visible scratches than do those of a higher grit
are used to smooth and refine surfaces; used to shorten and shape natural nails
feature grits of 240 and higher. They are designed for buffing, polishing, and removing very fine scratches.

meaning.en: Barrier that seals moisture into the skin
meaning.zh: 一层屏障，把水分锁在皮肤里

meaning.en: Soaks into the nail plate for flexibility
meaning.zh: 渗进甲板，让指甲更柔韧

tip.en: Cream sits on top like a lid and keeps water in. Oil soaks into the nail.
tip.zh: 护甲霜（cream）像锅盖一样盖在上面，把水分锁住。营养油（oil）会渗进指甲里。

evidence.quote: are barrier products: They contain ingredients designed to seal the surface of the skin around the nails and hold in the subdermal moisture in the skin
are designed to be absorbed into the nail plate to increase flexibility
